title: Answer the category attack honestly
evidence: Silver Fern 'lowering cortisol would make it worse' ads are top-20% by impressions (ranks 44 and 90 of 752); expert-led ads underperform (0.71x), creators outperform (1.11x)
how: A creator, not a lab-coat expert: 'You're right, it's not about crushing cortisol. It's about when it peaks.' 30-40 s.

title: Brand the phrase: AVIA name in the first 3 seconds
evidence: Bioma CORTISOL DETOX 165-167d; Harmonia challenge 120d; Her Bodhi 71d; formula.care app
how: Bottle and 'AVIA Cortisol Detox' in frame by 0:03 in every ad using the phrase.

title: Perimenopause 38-47: 'nobody warned me it starts with sleep'
evidence: Happy Mammoth 'too young' 10w 88d; Primal Queen 6/6 112d; Kalm and Her Bodhi skip this age
how: Peer tenure ('six months in') + 3 openers; stress and sleep only, no menopause claims.

title: Silent text card, 6-15 s, always on
evidence: Dose text card 178d, 10/11 won; Calm 11 s casting call 151d
how: Three lines on a colour field: symptom → curve → AVIA.

title: Cortisol-curve quiz funnel
evidence: Her Bodhi quiz 22/60 incl. /cortisol 3/3; Calm 43/50 ads to quiz; formula.care quiz
how: 5-question 'when does your curve peak?' quiz → AVIA routine.

title: '5 signs your cortisol peaks at the wrong time' listicle
evidence: Dose '4 reasons' listicle 22/22; Arctic Goddess /10-estrogen listicle 3/3
how: Listicle for cold traffic, PDP for warm.

title: Re-upload every 30-day survivor
evidence: Primal Queen manifesto died in 1 day, re-upload ran 103-108d under 5 ids; Dose relaunches winners
how: Relaunch winners under fresh ad ids each sale cycle.

title: Weekly watch of Bioma, Silver Fern, Thesis Stress Reset
evidence: Bioma cortisol test 22 Oct; Silver Fern attack wave; Thesis Stress Reset with free cortisol test kit
how: 15-minute weekly Atria scan of the three accounts that say AVIA's words.

title: Calm market: 'not a patience problem, a stress hormone'
evidence: Calm's #1 and #2 ads by impressions are text reframes: 'your nervous system needs a reset, not willpower', 'reactive behavior is not a flaw, it is biology'; top spend Sept-Oct on 'burnout is a nervous system stuck in survival mode'; no Calm ad says cortisol
how: 'Snapping at everyone isn't a patience problem. It's a stress hormone running on the wrong clock.' Text-on-screen first, then a creator. Calm/Headspace/meditation interests.
kpi: Hook rate; stop at -20% vs control after 5k
against: Calm's buyers bought an app; no one has shown they buy a supplement routine.

title: 8-second reframe cut: 'I thought it was X, it was a hormone'
evidence: Happy Mammoth top-impression 8 s 'I thought I had an anger problem, turns out a hormone problem'; Harmonia '100,000 people thought it was about the food' #1 of 110
how: Five cuts: snapping, 3 am waking, puffy face, 3 pm crash, belly. One line each, then the bottle.

title: Snapping and short temper as biology
evidence: Calm #1/#2 by impressions (reactive behavior is biology); Happy Mammoth anger-to-hormone cuts; Primal Queen 'hormones, not your marriage' (#1)
how: 'It isn't you. It's a stress hormone on the wrong clock.' No mood-disorder claims.

title: Dose cards: KSM-66 and the six others by name and dose
evidence: No supplement ad shows every milligram; 147 same-product openers mention doses or clinically studied (1.06x); MUD\WTR wins with a disclosed dose and attacks proprietary blends
how: Ingredient card per ingredient: name, dose, what its trials measured (perceived stress, serum cortisol, sleep). Ingredient evidence, not product claims.
against: Dose talk performs about average; buyers may not care about milligrams.

title: 'It's not you, it's your curve' reframe (not willpower)
evidence: Arctic Goddess 'hormonal resistance, not willpower' 117d; Her Bodhi 'it's not food' 71d; WarriorBabe 'metabolism isn't broken' (tests)
how: Identity absolution opener then the curve. Weight only as a felt late change.

title: Capsule over scoop: 'nothing to mix'
evidence: Harmonia 'one scoop, tastes like orange' everywhere; Dose shot; Kalm bracelet
how: 'Two capsules with breakfast. Nothing to mix, nothing to taste.' Kitchen counter b-roll.

title: Tired-and-wired woman: named-symptom confession
evidence: Silver Fern wired-but-tired 142d; Thesis Stress Reset 106d; Primal Queen named-symptom 11/12 134d
how: Open on 'wired at night, wiped by 3 pm'; symptom roll-call; the curve; 2-week felt change (sleep first).

title: Burned-out mom: morning-routine POV
evidence: Silver Fern burned-out mom 171d; Happy Mammoth raging mom 89d; Bearaby busy mom 101d
how: School-run POV; capsules with breakfast; 'self-care is a schedule, not a bath'.

evidence: Gaps at Arctic Goddess and Harmonia; Goli 'bowling ball face' winners; Primal Queen moon face 134d
how: Mirror at 6 am; 'it's not the salt from last night'; curve.
against: Inno Supps already owns the night-time cortisol face (19 winners).

evidence: Arctic Goddess 'no third coffee' testimonial; gaps at Harmonia and Arctic Goddess
how: Desk at 3 pm; coffee cup count; curve.
against: With 36 brands, sleep and energy openers show no clear edge (76 ads, 1.02x).

title: Taboo reverse warning: 'Do not take this if…'
evidence: Primal Queen taboo 7/9 132d; Bioma 'Do not buy Bioma' 167d; Bearaby 'do not buy'
how: 'Do not take this if you like waking at 3 am.' Calm/sleep/energy, not libido.

title: Named-symptom before/after confession container
evidence: Primal Queen 11/12 won, 134d
how: Photo-led peer reveal of a named symptom (cortisol face, 3 am phone); felt change only.

title: Narrated manifesto: symptom roll-call → the curve → tribe close
evidence: Primal Queen manifesto 15/18 108d (v2 opens on fog/3am/bloating/crashes 105d)

title: Talking cortisol character

title: 60-day 'two cycles' guarantee
evidence: Happy Mammoth 60d; Kalm 60d; Primal Queen 365d; Her Bodhi none
how: Test 60-day empty-bottle guarantee framed as 'give your curve two cycles' vs current 30-day returns.

evidence: Harmonia 'under a dollar a day' and 'from $39.99'; Her Bodhi up to 60% off on 73/78 ads
how: Replace rotating variants with one bundle and per-day price; one dated BF sale.

title: Fortnightly cohorts of 5-10 ads
evidence: Dose cohorts every 1-3 weeks; Primal Queen batches of 10-18
how: One body per container, 3-5 openers, launch together, kill as a cohort.

title: Short cuts for volume, one long story as a test
evidence: Top impressions go to 6-15 s cuts (Harmonia #1 of 110, Happy Mammoth 8 s) and to long dramas (RYZE 4-11 min at #1, #2, #5; Harmonia 11-18 min advertorials); 15-30 s 1.10x
how: Most ads 15-60 s; always-on 6-15 s cuts; one 3-5 minute story drama per month.

title: Goli market: the full formula for buyers already taking ashwagandha for cortisol
asset: new opener on best UGC body
evidence: Goli fit confirmed; its #1 ad by impressions and October creator ads name cortisol ('what happens when you get control of your high cortisol'); cortisol is a side benefit of one gummy
how: 'You've been taking ashwagandha for cortisol. Here's the full morning formula, at the doses studied.' Goli/ashwagandha/gummy interests.
kpi: Hook rate vs control after 5k impressions; CPA

title: RYZE market: 'keep the cup' pairing opener
evidence: RYZE top dramas say 'you don't have a weight problem, you have a stress problem' and 'reishi supports healthy cortisol levels' (ranks #1, #2, #5); fit confirmed
how: 'You already swapped your coffee to calm your stress. Keep the cup. Cortisol gets its own formula.' Mushroom-coffee and adaptogen interests.

title: Long story drama (3-5 min) with the hormone as the turning point
evidence: RYZE 4-11 minute betrayal/glow-up dramas rank #1, #2, #5 by impressions; Harmonia 11-18 minute advertorials
how: A woman's bad year, a friend's tip, the morning routine, felt changes only. One per month.
against: Long dramas are costly, and RYZE's results reflect RYZE's budget and audience.

title: Faceless week-by-week timeline with swappable openers
evidence: Zapply's 'what happens if he takes it for 30/90 days' is #1 of 3,073; Mars Men and Better Body Co run week 2/4/8 timelines; needs no talent
how: One body walking through weeks 1, 2, 4, 8 in 'many women notice' wording; 6+ openers that swap who it's about (3 am waker, 3 pm crasher, 40-year-old told she's too young).
kpi: Hook rate per opener, cost per purchase
notes: No weight or menopause promises in the timeline.
against: Every second leader runs a timeline now; it may read as a template.

title: Objection ladder: 'You said a cortisol supplement is just ashwagandha, so we answered'

against: Mira's own 'perimenopause or extreme stress' opener was barely shown in its one test.
